item.title: devp
item.description: A simple, TOML-configured process multiplexer for your terminal: a lighter-weight alternative to mprocs and procmux.

item.title: kube
item.description: A spatial-native data system with a memory-mapped .kube format, a sharded dataset format, a Python library, a CLI and a native 3D editor.

item.title: pmole
item.description: Compress an entire codebase into a single binary .pm file, with encryption, in-archive search, integrity verification and single-file extraction.

item.title: nyt
item.description: No YouTube. A self-hosted YouTube channel tracker that downloads new uploads and serves them through a clean web interface, with no algorithm or recommendations.
